title: Approve the 4×4 barograph
question: Same brass world, plus a 24-hour PSI trace from real NEA data (Central, 09:00 yesterday to 08:00 today). Pick the layout to build. Use the steer box for anything to carry over, e.g. 'A, but with a small capsule stack'.

options.label: A · Drum + plate
options.thesis: A full-width barograph drum carries the 24-hour trace; the PSI and AQI roller counters sit in the gunmetal base plate with the regions engraved along the edge.
options.viewport: Drum across the top 60%, big PSI counter and smaller AQI counter below, N/S/E/W and time engraved along the bottom.
options.risk: The least surprising of the three; the drum's band zones need to stay faint so only the current band reads.

options.label: B · Visible mechanism
options.thesis: The barograph's working parts on show: a silver aneroid capsule stack and brass lever drive the pen across the drum.
options.viewport: Drum upper-left, capsule stack and lever upper-right, counters on a full-width brass plaque below.
options.risk: The mechanism takes about a third of the width, compressing the 24-hour chart; regional readings are dropped; the base becomes brass rather than the small widget's gunmetal.

options.label: C · A at night
options.thesis: Layout A in its night finish: black chart paper, lume grid and trace, dimmed brass. Shown so you can judge A in both appearances.
options.risk: The band zones here are painted too strong; the build keeps only the current band lit.
